newsitem.title: UK: IBCA raises Banco Portugues do Atlantico.
newsitem.headline: IBCA raises Banco Portugues do Atlantico.

text.p: IBCA, the European credit rating agency, said on Monday it raised its ratings for Banco Portugues do Atlantico.
The short-term rating has been raised to A1 from A2 and the long-term rating to A from A minus.
The C individual rating and 2 legal rating of Banco Portugues do Atlantico (BPA) remain unchanged, IBCA said.
IBCA said in a statment the ratings were raised because of the financial strength of the BCP/BPA group and BPA's access to the resources of the enlarged group.
BPA was acquired by BCP and Companhia de Seguros Imperio, (Imperio), part of the Mello financial group, in March 1995, IBCA said.

BCP holds around 50 percent and Imperio about 46 percent of the shares of BPA, the balance is held by the market. Control of BPA's former subsidiary, Unio de Bancos Portugueses (UBP) has been transferred to the Mello Group, IBCA said.

BCP has restructured the BCP/BPA group such that BPA has acquired identical shareholdings to BCP in new specialised holding companies established to coordinate the group's activities in insurance, asset management, leasing and factoring, IBCA said.

In turn, BPA has acquired a 50 percent stake in the group's merchant bank, Banco CISF. Back-office and data processing functions have been centralised, while the group's treasury operation is now centralised within BPA, IBCA said.

New management has also undertaken an extensive review of BPA's activities. A number of areas, including the loan book, securities portfolio and pension commitments required additional provisions last year, largely taken to equity reserves.

The bank's total capital ratio is nevertheless adequate for the bank's strategy and business operations at the present time. The combined BCP/BPA group is Portugal's second largest banking group, controlling a market share of some 19 percent.
IBCA said its ratings for BCP remain unchanged, as follows at A1 short-term, A1, A long-term, B/C individual, 2 legal.
